title: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat answers from open tabs and YouTube videos
summary: Hold: the cloud-policy precedence guidance omits Microsoft's documented override, which can change which page-access setting wins on a device. The roadmap facts, licensing model and principal controls are supported, but the assertion that a prompt can read every open tab goes beyond the documentation.

claims.where: rationale: risk; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Copilot can read every open tab, or answer from all open tabs, in one contextual query.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot tabs all window Edge' and 'Copilot multi-tab limit'; searched archived Stable release notes for 'all open tabs' and 'every open tab'; read page-content support and EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext. Sources describe multiple tabs or an open window, not every tab.
claims.fix: Replace 'the content of every open tab' in the risk rationale with 'content from multiple open tabs'. Replace 'answer from all open tabs' in Governance guidance with 'answer contextual questions across multiple open tabs'.

claims.quote: Copilot can't access page content on pages protected by data loss prevention (DLP) policies, even if this policy is enabled.
claims.fix: Attribute the blanket DLP statement to the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext reference. Add: 'Separate Protected Session documentation describes an admin-enabled public preview from Edge 158 that can use supported protected content in the current tab, but not additional tabs; explicit AI-access blocks still apply.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-management-protected-session.
